info.title: proto-gen
info.description: CLI tool that scans compiled .NET assemblies for [ProtoContract] and [ProtoService] types, generates .proto schema files with configurable output routing, and optionally patches .csproj files to include the generated output.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show per-file message / service / import counts

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching the file system

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Assembly-level configuration (place in any .cs file in your project):
[assembly: ProtoToolOptions(
ProtoPath = "Contracts/Proto",
Routes = [
new ProtoTypeRoute("requests",  "Request", "Query"),
new ProtoTypeRoute("responses", "Response", "Result"),
new ProtoTypeRoute("messages",  "Message", "Event"),
]
)]
